# Prosper or Perish - crop farm location and country gates.
# Generated by `ppc crop-farms --write` from config/crop_farms.toml; do not edit by hand.

pp_wheat_farm_location_potential = {
	is_ownable = yes
	pp_general_farmable_food_location_potential = yes
	OR = {
		raw_material = goods:wheat
		AND = {
			NOT = { OR = { climate = arctic climate = ha1300_climate_subarctic } }
			NOT = { OR = { vegetation = jungle vegetation = ha1300_veg_tundra } }
		}
	}
}

pp_rice_farm_location_potential = {
	is_ownable = yes
	pp_general_farmable_food_location_potential = yes
	OR = {
		raw_material = goods:rice
		AND = {
			OR = {
				climate = tropical
				climate = ha1300_climate_tropical_monsoon
				climate = subtropical
				climate = ha1300_climate_subtropical_monsoon
				climate = ha1300_climate_continental_monsoon
				climate = ha1300_climate_highland_monsoon
				climate = ha1300_climate_savanna
				climate = mediterranean
			}
			OR = {
				has_river = yes
				is_adjacent_to_lake = yes
				topography = wetlands
				topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains
				topography = ha1300_topo_deltas
				vegetation = ha1300_veg_marsh
				vegetation = ha1300_veg_swamp
			}
		}
	}
}

pp_potato_farm_location_potential = {
	is_ownable = yes
	pp_general_farmable_food_location_potential = yes
	OR = {
		raw_material = goods:potato
		AND = {
			NOT = { climate = arctic }
			OR = {
				NOT = { OR = { climate = tropical climate = ha1300_climate_tropical_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_savanna climate = arid climate = ha1300_climate_hot_steppe } }
				topography = hills
				topography = mountains
				topography = plateau
			}
		}
	}
}

	is_ownable = yes

}

pp_cattle_farm_location_potential = {
	is_ownable = yes
	OR = {
		pp_pasture_friendly_location_potential = yes
		pp_general_farmable_food_location_potential = yes
	}
	OR = {
		raw_material = goods:livestock
		NOT = { climate = arctic }
	}
}

pp_rice_native_country = {
	original_capital ?= {
		OR = {
			sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
			sub_continent = sub_continent:middle_east
			sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
			sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
			sub_continent = sub_continent:west_africa
			region = region:central_africa_region
			region = region:egypt_region
			region = region:great_lakes_region
			region = region:iberia_region
			region = region:italy_region
			region = region:madagascar_region
			region = region:swahili_coast_region
			region = region:zimbabwe_region
		}
	}
}
